name: ticketwise
description: AI support assistant: answers questions from your help docs and past tickets with citations, drafts agent replies, and works in Slack. Runs on AWS Lambda + Postgres/pgvector.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck -w @ticketwise/api && npm run typecheck -w @ticketwise/admin && npm run typecheck -w @ticketwise/infra
scripts.build:demo: npm run build && npm run build:demo -w @ticketwise/admin
scripts.synth: npm run build && npm run synth -w @ticketwise/infra
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run build -w @ticketwise/admin && npm run deploy -w @ticketwise/infra
